text: How do I update the credit card on my account? Go to Settings, then Billing, and click Update payment method.
I was charged twice this month. Double charges are usually a pending authorization; they clear within 3 business days.
Where can I download my invoices? Invoices are available under Billing History as PDF downloads for the last 24 months.
Do you offer annual billing discounts? Annual plans save 20 percent compared to monthly billing.
My coupon code is not working. Coupons apply only to new subscriptions and cannot be combined with other offers.
How do refunds work? Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days of approval.
I forgot my password. Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page to receive a reset email.
How do I enable two-factor authentication? Go to Security settings and follow the authenticator app setup.
Can I change my username? Usernames can be changed once every 30 days from Profile settings.
How do I delete my account? Account deletion is under Settings, Danger Zone, and takes 14 days to complete.
Why is my account locked? Accounts lock after 5 failed sign-in attempts; wait 15 minutes or contact support.
How do I add team members? Invite teammates from the Team page by email; they receive an invitation link.
Where is my order? Track your shipment from the Orders page using the tracking number in your confirmation email.
How long does standard shipping take? Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days within the contiguous US.
Do you ship internationally? We ship to over 40 countries; duties are calculated at checkout.
My package arrived damaged. Report damage within 7 days with photos for a replacement or refund.
Can I change my delivery address? Addresses can be changed before the order ships from the Orders page.
What is express shipping cost? Express 2-day shipping costs a flat 12.99 USD per order.
The app crashes on startup. Clear the app cache or reinstall; ensure your OS meets the minimum version.
How do I export my data? Use Settings, Data, Export to download a CSV or JSON archive of your data.
Is there an API? Yes, REST API documentation is available in the Developer portal with rate limits of 1000 calls per hour.
The dashboard is loading slowly. Try a hard refresh; persistent slowness may indicate a regional outage on the status page.
How do I connect a custom domain? Add a CNAME record pointing to our servers, then verify in Domain settings.
Webhooks are not firing. Check the webhook signing secret and confirm your endpoint returns a 200 within 5 seconds.

What is the return window? Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
How do I start a return? Start a return from the Orders page and print the prepaid shipping label.
Do return shipping costs apply? Return shipping is free for defective items; otherwise 6.99 USD is deducted.
When will I get my refund? Refunds process within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item.
Can I exchange an item? Exchanges are handled as a return plus a new order to keep inventory accurate.
What items are final sale? Clearance items marked final sale cannot be returned.
